description: Originally designed for boaters and fishermen to have a firm foothold even on slippery surfaces, crocs has gone a  long way in creating footwear for those who demand comfort. Replete with several benefits such as the shoe moulding to your feet with the use of body warmth, it's a hot favourite among most people. The midsole band found in all of crocs footwear is a tribute to the classic vulcanized style of yesteryear footwear. Incredibly easy to clean, Crocs makes for a great footwear when working in the garden or in wet and messy conditions. The speciality of these shoes are that they need to Fit loosely around the feet, such that neither the sides of the shoe nor the toe unit come in contact with the feet. Instead, there should be a quarter to half inch gap between the foot and the wall of the shoe, and you should be able to comfortably fit a finger between the heel and back strap. product_name: Nike Women Air Mir Ma Purple Blue Shoe
description: Originally designed as a cross training shoe, the nike Air Max Trainer Excel has become a big time favourite gym footwear. Replete with a meshed upper and cushioned footbed, and weighing all of about 280 grams, the nike Air Max Trainer Excel is an absolute comfort, maximizing workout sessions. Styled with an aesthetic appeal and engineered with comfort, the Nike Air Max Trainer Excel has a nearly meshed upper that ensures ample ventilation and breathability, keeping the feet dry and comfortable during those sweaty sessions. The uppers are constructed using synthetic overlays to ensure a lockdown Fit. Added to this is a lightly padded tongue and collar that ensures a comfortable, snug fit, while the lace-up system provides an even better snug and supportive fit. The lacing system is integrated with Nike’s revolutionary Flywire technology with its high strength threadwork, like that of cables used in suspension bridges, constructed exactly at those places where the foot needs that extra support. Run on air even on rock The forefoot inner sleeve is seamless and has an underlay support frame for that extra stability and comfort. The insole of the Nike Air Max Trainer Excel shoe has a textile lining that fits snugly around the foot, enhancing shock absorption and keeping the feet safe from impact. The shock absorption technology in the Nike Air Max Trainer Excel has a low profile phylon midsole that is employed with a 180° Max Air unit to provide optimal cushioning and impact protection. The comfort factor doesn’t end just here. The phylite midsole and outsole are fused to reduce the overall weight. The outsole of the Nike Air Max Trainer Excel is constructed with siped flex grooves on the forefoot to provide that ultimate multi-directional flexibility, while the strategically placed rubber pods on the outsole enhance traction and durability, making this rubber outsole engineered shoe an absolute pleasure to wear during training sessions. Built with patented sole technology, the reebok ZigFuel maximizes energy return to the feet, offering a soft and springy ride: a complete energy drink for your feet that makes your key leg muscles so that you can do more. This is separated into a different panel altogether from heel to mid-foot and onto the forefoot to reduce impact on key muscle groups when running, providing a smooth heel to toe transition. Energetic from kick-off Light and energetic from the word Go, the Reebok ZigFuel reduces impact on the heel, which is especially beneficial for midfoot to heelstrike runners who land on their heels first. The Zig technology, coupled with the DMX Shear cushioning panels reduces impact and evenly distributes shock, returning maximum energy to the feet. This reduced heel stress and extra comfort allows you to run longer and stronger. In short, if you're looking for a shoe that adds fuel to your runs with that extra cushioned support and strainless experience for your shins, feet and glutes, the ZigFuel is what you need. product_name: Nike Men's Lunar Swift 2 Black Shoe
description: EXPERIENCE THE JOY OF FRESH RUNS An absolutely dynamic running shoe, the nike Lunarswift+ offers seamless comfort, distance-busting cushioning and runner specific support. Offering soft cushioning and support with every stride, the nike Lunarswift+ features a LunarLite cushioning system that ensures a springy effect for the feet. The Nike Lunarswift+ range of shoes a low profile midsole that ensures a firmer feel to the underfoot. It’s a highly recommended shoe for underpronators and overpronators with ample cushioning and stability provided in the medial and lateral side of the shoe. Breezy touch to snug shoes With a stitchless upper, Nike Lunarswift+ shoes reduce irritation to the feet and enhance the comfort factor. The upper of these shoes are constructed using lightweight synthetic mesh and synthetic overlays ensuring ample ventilation for the feet, keeping them dry and comfortable even during long runs. To test the breathability aspect, wear really thin socks and move around in the Nike Lunarswift+ and feel the breeze moving in and out. Added to this is a robust heel counter that provides an absolutely snug and secure Fit to the rearfoot. Adapts to the runner's needs Light in weight and weighing just about 306 grams, this range of shoes are employed with Lunarlon cushioning system in the midsole that is made up of a soft, resilient foam core. This is encased in a supportive foam carrier ensuring a lightweight blend of plush cushioning and springy response. This support platform is dynamic enough to respond to the runner’s changing needs. It adopts to the wearer’s stride through each run giving the right amount of support and stability. No wonder overpronators prefer the Nike Lunarswift+ as the wedged carrier foam in the Lunarlon system limits excessive pronation, without adding weight or stiffness of a traditional medial post. When it comes to neutral pronators, this pronation control feature is not activated. For such runners, the dynamic support platform enhances cushioning, converting this same shoe into a neutral running shoe. Stay safe in the dark The outsole of the Nike Lunarswift+ has flex grooves along its length and breadth ensuring flexibility in every stride. Constructed with an outsole using environmentally preferred rubber and a waffle pattern outsole, the shoe is absolutely high on traction and durability. Added to these features are the reflective elements used in the shoe to ensure that you are visible even when running in low visibility conditions, keeping you safe. Belonging to the Nike+ range, the Nike Lunarswift+ is compatible with all Nike+ products and actually talks to your iPod nano and other compatible gauging devices. So enjoy those long runs through all seasons in this pleasurable range of Nike Lunarswift+ shoes. Upper   Open mesh upper made of synthetic leather for ample breathability  Microfiber synthetic overlays in the forefoot and rearfoot for snug fit  Heel counter moulded onto the shoe and wrapped around rearfoot for stability of the heel  Moulded sockliner anatomically placed for underfoot cushioning and ergonomical comfort   Midsole   LunarLite technology employed with foam core bonded to a phylon carrier for enhanced cushioning and increased energy return  Dynamic support layers along the foam core to produce a denser medial midsole to reduce overpronation  Cuboid pod in lower lateral side of midfoot   Outsole   BRS 1000 carbon rubber on the heel counter for added durability  EPR forefoot for multi-surface traction  Waffle outsole design on forefoot for multi-surface traction and cushioning   Shoe care Wipe surface with soft, clean, damp cloth to remove dust Do not machine wash

product_name: Nike Men's Lunarelite Grey Red Shoe
description: SHAPED FOR YOUR EVERY STRIDE  Incredibly  lightweight with a smooth transition, the nike LunarElite+ model of  shoes for men are designed for those who love to run. Without  sacrificing on cushioning and shock absorption, the nike LunarElite+  range of shoes is designed in such a manner that it adapts to your  stride &ndash  be it long or short.  Great deal for underpronators and overpronators  The Nike  LunarElite+ range of shoes are specially engineered for runners with  underpronated to moderately overpronated gait. Underpronated and  overpronated runners strike the ground at the lateral side of the heel.  As the individual transfers weight from the heel to the metatarsus, the  foot doesn&rsquo t roll enough in the medial (inside) direction for  overpronators and in the lateral (outside) direction for underpronators,  which could affect the knee as the foot doesn&rsquo t absorb shock properly.  However, the difference lies in the fact that in an underpronator, the  ankles do not experience much motion and are rigid, while in an  overpronator, the ankles roll inwards making one fall forward easily.  Nike realized that it had the responsibility to create the right running shoes that could cater to both underpronators and overpronators, with  ample support on both, the lateral and medial sides. This responsibility  that it took up resulted in the creation of the Nike LunarElite+ model  of shoes.  360 degrees of comfort  Without  sacrificing on cushioning, the Nike LunarElite+ range of shoes was  created with ultra-light, yet ultra-strong Flywire upper. The Flywire is  a lightweight support system that is made of tensile fibres that are  joined together to create a foundation to construct the upper material  of the shoe. It acts like a super strong synthetic ligament, wrapping  around the foot and supporting it precisely where it needs that extra  support, mapping the foot morphology like an X-ray. Flywire acts like  the second skin giving the runner that ultimate freedom and strength in  moving backwards, forwards, sideways, up and down. Think of the  direction and Nike LunarElite+ shoes will help you move that way with  complete convenience, locking your foot down.  This  range of shoes is created with open mesh uppers with strategic overlays  for enhanced support at targeted areas of the upper foot to enhance  performance, comfort and breathability. The no-sew design employed in  key zones ensure proper fitting and enhance comfort.  To add to  this snug Fit of the upper is the Lunarlon cushioning system in the  midsole that adds on a plush cushioning to absorb shock protecting the  feet, besides adding that extra spring in gait. The dynamic support  system adapts to the runner&rsquo s stride, adding that specific support to  every phase of the run.  Ultimate in protection  Besides,  Nike LunarElite+ shoes are engineered with a dual layer Ortholite insole  that is strong and breathable, replete with anti-microbial foam, making  this model of shoes ideal for athletes. The cushioned sockliner is made  of long lasting material and adds an exceptional step-in feel, while  the memory foam at the collar ensures absolute comfort and fit.  The Nike  LunarElite+ range of shoes are made of environmentally preferred rubber  and employ a modified waffle outsole that makes the shoes durable and  multi-surface tractional. The heel unit is made of highly durable carbon  rubber, reducing wear and tear, while the flex grooves enhance  flexibility, ensuring a smooth and efficient Nike run.  Shoe care 1. Brush surface with a soft, clean, damp cloth to remove dust 2. Do not machine wash

product_name: ADIDAS Men Response Cushion White Blue Shoe
description: HIGH TECH MACHINE, SIMPLY DESIGNED  When hardcore durability meets soft, cushioned touch, you get what's  called the adidas Response Cushion 19. An absolute dream-come-true for a  runner, the adidas Response Cushion 19 boasts of an increased  cushioning all around the foot making it a pleasure for the feet.  With a meshed material on the inside and outside of the upper, the feet  are provided with ample breathability and ventilation in these shoes.  Now that the feet are safe from getting heavy with sweat and chances of  infection ruled out in these shoes, Adidas added on its trademark three  stripes in the form of synthetic overlays on the upper, anchoring the  laces and keeping them locked in place for enhanced midfoot function and  support.   Stability at its best  Weighing all of just about 349 grams for men's shoes and 281 grams for  women's shoes, the Adidas Response Cushion 19 features a Torsion system  in the midsole for enhanced stability that ensures a lesser side-to-side  foot movement and more efficient heelstrike to forefoot motion. In  fact, most users of the Adidas Response Cushion 19 vouch for its midfoot  support system that makes this shoe absolutely energy efficient and  comfortable.  A high tech running machine hidden under a simple design, the durability  of the Adidas Response Cushion 19 is driven by the trademark AdiWEAR  system in the outsole. This outsole is made of tough rubber that not  only enhances shoe life, but also promotes traction at its best. As a  cherry on the icing, the Adidas Response Cushion 19 shoe has also  employed an adiPRENE system that provides ultimate cushioning and impact  protection, retaining foot propulsion keeping the runner moving forward  without wasting energy unnecessarily.  If running is what gives you the greatest pleasure, then grab for  yourself this Adidas Response Cushion 19, add on an iPod to your  enjoyment and enjoy long runs in the wilderness. Wash care 1. Remove dust with soft, clean, damp cloth 2. Do not machine wash

product_name: Nike Men Lunarswi +2 Orange Black Shoe
description: EXPERIENCE THE JOY OF FRESH RUNS An absolutely dynamic running shoe, the nike Lunarswift+ offers seamless comfort, distance-busting cushioning and runner specific support. Offering soft cushioning and support with every stride, the nike Lunarswift+ features a LunarLite cushioning system that ensures a springy effect for the feet. The Nike Lunarswift+ range of shoes a low profile midsole that ensures a firmer feel to the underfoot. It’s a highly recommended shoe for underpronators and overpronators with ample cushioning and stability provided in the medial and lateral side of the shoe. Breezy touch to snug shoes With a stitchless upper, Nike Lunarswift+ shoes reduce irritation to the feet and enhance the comfort factor. The upper of these shoes are constructed using lightweight synthetic mesh and synthetic overlays ensuring ample ventilation for the feet, keeping them dry and comfortable even during long runs. To test the breathability aspect, wear really thin socks and move around in the Nike Lunarswift+ and feel the breeze moving in and out. Added to this is a robust heel counter that provides an absolutely snug and secure Fit to the rearfoot. Adapts to the runner's needs Light in weight and weighing just about 306 grams, this range of shoes are employed with Lunarlon cushioning system in the midsole that is made up of a soft, resilient foam core. This is encased in a supportive foam carrier ensuring a lightweight blend of plush cushioning and springy response. This support platform is dynamic enough to respond to the runner’s changing needs. It adopts to the wearer’s stride through each run giving the right amount of support and stability. No wonder overpronators prefer the Nike Lunarswift+ as the wedged carrier foam in the Lunarlon system limits excessive pronation, without adding weight or stiffness of a traditional medial post. When it comes to neutral pronators, this pronation control feature is not activated. For such runners, the dynamic support platform enhances cushioning, converting this same shoe into a neutral running shoe. Stay safe in the dark The outsole of the Nike Lunarswift+ has flex grooves along its length and breadth ensuring flexibility in every stride. Constructed with an outsole using environmentally preferred rubber and a waffle pattern outsole, the shoe is absolutely high on traction and durability. Added to these features are the reflective elements used in the shoe to ensure that you are visible even when running in low visibility conditions, keeping you safe. Belonging to the Nike+ range, the Nike Lunarswift+ is compatible with all Nike+ products and actually talks to your iPod nano and other compatible gauging devices. So enjoy those long runs through all seasons in this pleasurable range of Nike Lunarswift+ shoes.
